Success background oklch(0.96 0.03 160) = #E1F8EB against --success-100 oklch(0.95 0.04 160) = #D9F7E5 — 8 units apart. Both are visible on a full-width banner fill, so they cannot be folded into the existing step without changing what renders, and the two mockups that are the declared visual acceptance target (specs/user-management/02-authentication-login.mock.html lines 102-105 and specs/user-management/01-organization-creation.mock.html line 92) spell out the banner values verbatim while scripts/static-gate.mjs rule 1 forbids this run from editing them. That is the only choice available to an implementation run, and it is correct for this run, but a palette carrying two indistinguishable steps per hue is a design-system decision a human should ratify or reverse deliberately — in the spec and the mockups together, which only a human can change.
